high_level_description: The image shows three individuals standing indoors, likely in a formal or semi-formal setting. The person in the center is wearing a traditional grey robe with white trim, which appears to be a type of thobe, commonly worn in Middle Eastern cultures. This individual also has a white cap on their head and is gesturing with both hands, pointing towards themselves. The two individuals on either side of the central figure are dressed in white robes that cover their heads and bodies, resembling the abaya, another traditional garment often worn by men in the region.
